added_items.item: After the 24-hour key expiry window, do not retry with the same key; check charge state first
Use a new key for a new purchase attempt; if cart or card changes, do not reuse the old key
Stripe saves and replays the result of the first request including errors, so a retry with the same key returns the same error
If the outcome cannot be confirmed after retries, look up the charge (by order ID in metadata or the dashboard) before creating a new one
Two server workers handling the same order can also double-charge; derive key from order ID
If retry logic wraps more than the Stripe call (e.g., order creation), the key must stay the same across all retries
